intent: The habit Module 1 teaches, as a flow with no verdict: ask who signs in as an agent, ask what its job needs, grant that and then remove the rest, and prove it with a refusal you trigger and find in the log.

regions.occupies: top 14% of the frame, full width
regions.contains: the title, top-left, on one line

regions.occupies: from about 22% to about 82% of the frame height, full width inside the margins
regions.contains: four equal tall cards in a row joined by three arrows

elements.shape: tall rounded rectangle card with a simple flat outline question-mark-in-circle icon at the top
elements.label: Who signs in as this?

elements.shape: tall rounded rectangle card with a simple flat outline question-mark-in-circle icon at the top
elements.label: What does its job need?
elements.sublabel: Compare the job to the grant

elements.shape: tall rounded rectangle card with a simple flat outline gear icon at the top
elements.label: Grant that, then remove the rest

elements.shape: tall rounded rectangle card with a simple flat outline gear icon at the top
elements.label: Prove it with a refusal
elements.sublabel: Trigger it, then read the log

connections.style: solid arrow, neutral grey, no label
solid arrow, neutral grey, no label
solid arrow, neutral grey, no label

text_exact.text: Compare the job to the grant
Grant that, then remove the rest
Trigger it, then read the log

mandatory: Exactly four cards of identical size in one row, joined left to right by three arrows
Cards 1 and 2 are soft amber; cards 3 and 4 are soft blue
Labels are bold near-black ink (#1F2328); sublabels are medium-weight near-black ink (#1F2328), never grey; text may wrap only at a space
The cards are tall and fill the flow band, so there is no large empty area
The title is bold, large, top-left and on one line
All text is large enough to read when the image is 1000px wide
prohibitions: NO third-party logos and NO Google logo
NO 'Vertex AI', 'Agent Engine', 'reasoning engine' or 'reasoningEngines' anywhere
NO project IDs, NO email addresses, NO 'projects/' paths, NO '@' characters
NO people, faces, hands, silhouettes or characters
NO text that is not listed in text_exact
NO check marks, ticks or crosses
NO green and NO red anywhere in the image
NO diamonds, NO yes/no branches and NO outcome boxes
NO kicker, eyebrow or category label above the title (never 'TECHNICAL DIAGRAM' or any similar small caps text)
alt_text: The title reads: What does this job need? Four tall cards joined by arrows, left to right. Two amber cards with question-mark icons: Who signs in as this? (One login per agent) and What does its job need? (Compare the job to the grant). Two blue cards with gear icons: Grant that, then remove the rest (Re-grant before you revoke) and Prove it with a refusal (Trigger it, then read the log).
